analyst.summary: Medanta (Global Health Ltd) is a leading Indian tertiary-care hospital group with a strong specialty mix, expanding bed capacity across six cities, and improving returns on capital as newer hospitals mature. Growth has been genuinely strong, though the trailing profit-growth rate is flattered by newer hospitals moving from loss-making ramp-up to profitability and should not be extrapolated at the same pace. The stock's rich valuation (~65-68x earnings, ~9.7x book) already reflects much of this success. We rate this a Hold.
